title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size
tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

exact_text.read_as: Square and portrait: Fern House. Landscape: missing.
Square and portrait: Weekend Plant Sale. Landscape: Weekend Plant Sale, but the top of 'Weekend Plant' is clipped.
Square and portrait: Visit 24 Willow Lane. Landscape: Visit 24 Willow, clipped at the bottom; Lane is missing.

faults.what: The landscape image crops away 'Fern House', clips the top of 'Weekend Plant', and cuts off the address, including the entire word 'Lane'.
The landscape variant appears to be a vertical crop of the square layout rather than a rearranged composition, leaving oversized text running beyond the canvas.

judge.summary: The square and portrait ads are readable and visually matched, but the landscape version is severely cropped and loses essential text.

must_haves.item: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: The three delivered canvases visibly match the requested square, portrait, and landscape proportions.

must_haves.item: All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
must_haves.why: The landscape omits the brand name and the end of the address, and clips the headline.

must_haves.item: Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
must_haves.why: Square and portrait text is large and readable, but essential landscape text is cropped or absent.

must_haves.item: Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
must_haves.why: White lettering contrasts clearly with the darkened backing, and leaves do not materially obscure the visible lettering.

must_haves.item: No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
must_haves.why: The landscape headline and address extend beyond the top and bottom edges.

must_haves.item: The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.
must_haves.why: The leafy imagery and palette match, but the landscape retains the square's stacked layout instead of adapting it to the wider canvas.
